original:
Let $T>0$ , and let $q=a/b>0$ , where $a,b$ are coprime
positive integers. Suppose that $[A,B]$ and $[c,d]$ are closed
intervals, with $0<A\leq B<T$ . There exist $k\in\{0,\ldots,b-1\}$ 
and $r\in[A,B]$ such that

 $R=Tk+r,\qquad U=\frac{a}{b}R,\qquad U\in[c,d]\pmod{T}$ 

if and only if

(13)

 $\left\lceil\frac{bc-aB}{T}\right\rceil\leq\left\lfloor\frac{bd-aA}{T}\right\rfloor.$ 

In particular, such $R,U$ exist whenever

(14)

 $a(B-A)+b(d-c)\geq T.$
